purpose: Separate immediate AI-assisted performance from later unaided retention, reasoning, and transfer, while preserving negative, null, and scaffold-sensitive evidence.

evidence.title: ChatGPT as a cognitive crutch: Evidence from a randomized controlled trial on knowledge retention
evidence.author: Andre Barcaui

design.delayed_outcome: surprise knowledge-retention test 45 days after learning

limitations_to_retain: single bounded learning context does not establish population-wide cognitive decline
retention is not identical to broad reasoning or cross-domain transfer
mechanistic explanation should not be promoted beyond the measured outcomes

evidence.title: ChatGPT as a Learning Tool for Medical Students: Results From a Randomized Controlled Trial

design.delayed_outcome: same quiz repeated one week later without access to resources

limitations_to_retain: same-quiz one-week retention is narrower than novel transfer

evidence.title: Human-centered GenAI feedback design in higher education: a multisite experiment on direct, reflective, and hybrid approaches to scientific argumentation
evidence.journal: International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education

reported_results.immediate: direct GenAI improved immediate argument-quality gain relative to peer feedback; hybrid showed the highest adjusted immediate argument-quality mean
reported_results.process: reflective and hybrid conditions showed stronger feedback uptake and self-regulated learning
reported_results.delayed_ai_free_transfer: reflective and hybrid conditions outperformed direct GenAI-supported feedback

evidence.interpretive_boundary: The evidence supports interaction-design sensitivity: preserving self-evaluation, reflection, peer critique, and learner agency can improve delayed AI-free transfer relative to direct GenAI feedback. It does not establish that every reflective/hybrid AI design is beneficial.

current_synthesis.negative_lane: unrestricted ChatGPT can be associated with worse later retention in a bounded randomized design
current_synthesis.null_lane: a small medical-student RCT found no significant one-week retention difference
current_synthesis.positive_scaffold_lane: reflective/hybrid GenAI feedback outperformed direct GenAI feedback on delayed AI-free transfer in a large multisite experiment
current_synthesis.topic_implication: AI access alone is an insufficient explanatory variable. The research model must represent interaction design, cognitive responsibility retained by the learner, timing, and the exact unaided outcome.

remaining_required_evidence: independent replications of delayed negative retention effects
delayed novel reasoning transfer rather than same-material retention only
longer longitudinal follow-up beyond weeks to months
direct head-to-head answer-generation versus hinting/Socratic/counterexample designs
